pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
Forest-themed shield. Functions like a vanilla shield: right-click to block, negates damage, consumes durability.

• Durability: 672 (2x vanilla shield). Enchantable.
• Blocking reflects 2 thorns damage to attackers within 3 blocks (ignores armor)
• Player use: reflected attacker receives infinite Poison

pages.title: Forest Doll Synergy
pages.text:
Forest Doll offhand: 100% damage reflection.

Repair: oak logs.

pages.text: Oak logs surround an iron block.
